interpretation: Both baseline and candidate reproduce missing native click after Enter on enabled/focused intended Select, with adapter Pan and no rejection reason. Baseline late capture shows no activation after 2 seconds and keyboard events not cancelled at dispatch completion. The candidate first capture uses microtask cancellation observations, which precede later listeners and do not establish final defaultPrevented state.

Camera/source rendering was unfinished at focus preparation in the baseline captured failure; original fixture had no restored-camera/render synchronization before the keyboard phase. Readiness barrier corrects that preparation gap while keeping native Enter and assertions.

Readiness experiment passes all four configurations at widths1200/375; this alone does not establish the browser-internal reason the native click was absent or prove the cause of Alfred original uncaptured failure. No production keyboard fix claimed.

Standalone native-button probe after simple right-button drag passed40/40; this does not establish or exclude the cause in the MapLibre prelude. Native context-menu cancellation was ultimately true in baseline late capture; no native-menu workaround added.
